node.statement: Compressed-unit estimate from lem-compcb-compressed-unit-norm: the one-dimensional delta-projection Q is nonvanishing by the registered one-dimensional-projection-nonvanishing definition, so for e below the lemma threshold abs(||u_Q||-1)<=C_u e. Hence the parent holds with A=C_r+1, B=C_u and the minimum of the two universal thresholds.
